environmentConstruction: Start from the agent shell environment; scrub inherited Git repository/config and stage receipt bindings before the comparator.
Mirror publication runtime-setting removal and retain gate, privacy and publication settings for the isolated rehearsal.
Use fresh HOME, XDG_CONFIG_HOME, TMPDIR and LLV_STATE_DIR for every run.
Publisher mode removes the four GIT_AUTHOR_NAME, GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL, GIT_COMMITTER_NAME and GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL fields; agent mode retains them.
The parent carries no author or committer dates. These four identity fields are the controlled difference between the two modes.
The comparator creates another private environment per explicit file; the preload confines global config, templates and generated hooks.
review: The merge writer requires native MERGE_HEAD state and preserves positional arguments. Existing starts require independent commit receipts, including versionless starts. Native fixtures prepare real launch bindings; existing successor, PR and rebase assertions stay enabled.
